Wren Calloway-Sato

Portland, OR | (555) 0142-9863 | wren.callowaysato@example.com

github.com/wrencalloway  |  linkedin.com/in/wrencallowaysato  |  wrencalloway.example.dev

SUMMARY

Software engineer with three years of experience building web applications and the services behind them, mostly in TypeScript and Python. Comfortable across the stack but happiest working on APIs, data models, and test infrastructure. Looking for a mid-level product engineering role on a team that ships to real users regularly.

EXPERIENCE

Software Engineer	April 2023 - Present

Marrow & Finch Software - Portland, OR

Own the appointments API (TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL) serving roughly 85,000 bookings per week across 340 clinic accounts.

Cut p95 availability-search latency from 1.9 seconds to 240 milliseconds by replacing per-slot queries with a precomputed availability index refreshed on write.

Reduced failed bookings caused by double-allocation to near zero (from about 120 per week) by moving slot reservation into a single serializable transaction.

Set up the seed-data and factory layer that the whole backend test suite now uses; integration test runtime dropped from 14 minutes to 5.

Junior Software Engineer	September 2022 - March 2023

Pemberton Grove Health Tech - Portland, OR

Built the patient intake form flow in React, including offline draft saving and resumable uploads for insurance documents.

Migrated 22 legacy jQuery pages to the component library, which removed 11,000 lines of duplicated code and shrank the main bundle by 38%.

Wrote the team's first accessibility checklist after an audit found 40+ issues; all were closed within one quarter.

Software Engineering Intern	June 2021 - August 2021

Alder Point Labs - Eugene, OR

Implemented a batch export tool that saved the support team an estimated six hours per week of manual CSV assembly.

Added continuous integration to three internal repositories that had none.

EDUCATION

B.S. Computer Science	2018 - 2022

Cascadia Vale University - Eugene, OR

Minor in Linguistics. GPA 3.58. Undergraduate teaching assistant for Intro to Programming for four terms.

Senior project: a speech-to-text alignment tool for oral history archives, built with a community partner.

SKILLS

Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, SQL, Ruby (familiar), Bash

Frameworks: React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, Django, Vitest, Jest, Cypress

Data: PostgreSQL, SQLite, Redis, Prisma, Drizzle ORM, Elasticsearch

Infrastructure: Docker, AWS (EC2, RDS, S3), Fly.io, GitHub Actions, Sentry, Terraform (basic)

PROJECTS

Fieldnote - github.com/wrencalloway/fieldnote

An offline-first note-taking app for field researchers, built with local-first sync over CRDTs. About 600 stars; used by two university field programs.

seedpacket - github.com/wrencalloway/seedpacket

A small library for generating realistic, referentially-consistent test data from a database schema. Write-up at wrencalloway.example.dev/posts/seedpacket.
